def lxc_create(name, template=None):
    """
    creates a new container
    """
    command = "lxc-create -n {} -t {}".format(name, template)
    return command


def lxc_attach(name):
    """
    attach to a container
    """
    command = "lxc-attach -n {}".format(name)
    return command


def lxc_destroy(name):
    """
    destroy a container
    """
    command = "lxc-destroy -n {}".format(name)
    return command


def lxc_stop(name):
    """
    stop a container
    """
    command = "lxc-stop -n {}".format(name)
    return command


def lxc_start(name):
    """
    start a container
    """
    command = "lxc-start -n {}".format(name)
    return command


def lxc_copy(name, source, destination):
    """
    copy a file from a container
    """
    command = "lxc-copy -n {} -s {} {}".format(name, source, destination)
    return command


def lxc_execute(name, command):
    """
    execute a command in a container
    """
    command = "lxc-execute -n {} {}".format(name, command)
    return command


def lxc_info(name):
    """
    get information about a container
    """
    command = "lxc-info -n {}".format(name)
    return command


def lxc_list():
    """
    list the containers
    """
    command = "lxc-list"
    return command
